scope: isolated observed-static initialization with dynamic fallback; experimental simulation only
input_covariance: patched native world small rotation / world physical base position; OpenCV axes, row major; local conditional information transformed with lever arm
output_covariance: ROS world position, world-fixed infinitesimal rotation; full Jacobian with cross terms
position_covariance_basis: constant OpenCV-to-FLU basis, without additional pose rotation
marginalization_precision: float64 SVD/inverse/Schur; unchanged 1e-6 singular cutoff and float state storage

stationary_initialization.accelerometer_bias: zero calibrated prior; not observed at rest
stationary_initialization.history: latest 6 keyframes; original 20-keyframe dynamic initialization retained

low_residual_information: refresh actual observation and IMU Hessian, with unchanged bias freeze and Schur cutoff
